battle_traits.name: Anointed Ritualist
battle_traits.declare: If there are no friendly anointed units on the battlefield, pick a friendly non-Unique DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE Hero on the battlefield to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: The target is anointed for the rest of the battle, even if it has been destroyed. Friendly anointed units on the battlefield treat EXALTED abilities on the warscrolls of friendly anointed units that have been destroyed as if they were on their warscroll.

battle_traits.name: Bloody Succession
battle_traits.effect: Each time a friendly anointed unit is destroyed, after removing it from play, you can immediately use the 'Anointed Ritualist' ability as if it were the start of the first battle round.

battle_traits.name: Strident War Cry
battle_traits.timing: Reaction: You declared a Charge ability for an anointed unit
battle_traits.effect: Pick a friendly non-Hero DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit that is not in combat, is wholly within 12" of that anointed unit and has not charged this turn to be the target. If that anointed unit charges, after that CHARGE ability has been resolved, the target can immediately use the 'Charge' ability even if it is not your charge phase. In addition, you can re-roll charge rolls for the target for the rest of the phase.

battle_traits.name: Blood Rites
battle_traits.effect:
You perform a blood rite each time:
• An enemy unit is destroyed and any damage points were allocated to that unit by a friendly anointed unit's combat attacks in the same turn.
• A friendly anointed unit is destroyed.
• A friendly unit contesting an objective you control is destroyed.
• An enemy unit is destroyed by a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit's attacks and any models in that enemy unit were contesting an objective you do not control in the same phase.
• A unit (friendly or enemy) is destroyed and it was within 3" of a Place of Power at the start of the phase.
Only one blood rite can be performed per unit destroyed.

battle_traits.name: Blessings of Khaine
battle_traits.declare: You can only use this ability if you performed any blood rites this turn.
battle_traits.effect:
Pick 1 of the following blessings that is not active. That blessing is active. While a blessing is active, its effect applies to friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE units. The effects of more than 1 blessing can apply to a unit at the same time.
• Blessing of Ruthlessness: Add 1 to hit rolls for those units' combat attacks.
• Blessing of Hatred: Add 1 to wound rolls for those units' combat attacks.
• Blessing of Haste: Add 3" to those units' Move characteristic.
• Blessing of Zeal: If those units charged in the same turn, they have WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn.
• Blessing of Shadow: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target those units.
• Blessing of Cruelty: Those units can use CHARGE and/or SHOOT abilities even if they have used a RETREAT ability in the same turn.
• Blessing of Clarity: Add 1 to chanting rolls and casting rolls for those units.

abilities.name: The Breath of Khaine
abilities.effect: While each model in a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit is contesting an objective you control, those models are not visible to enemy models more than 9" away.

abilities.name: Bloody-Handed Worshippers
abilities.timing: Reaction: You declared a Fight ability for an anointed unit
abilities.effect: Pick a friendly non-HERO DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within that anointed unit's combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by that anointed unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target's melee weapons have Crit (Auto-wound) for the rest of the turn. If its melee weapons already have Crit (Auto-wound), they have Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the turn instead.

abilities.name: Heretic's Bane
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy WIZARD or PRIEST on the battlefield to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice for each objective you control. For each 3+, subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Final Frenzy
abilities.declare: Pick each friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit contesting an objective to be the targets.
abilities.effect:
Return up to D3 slain models to each target that has a Health characteristic of up to 2.
Return up to 1 slain model to each target that that has a Health characteristic of 3 or more.

abilities.name: Higher Purpose
abilities.effect: Return D3 slain models to each friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY unit.

abilities.name: Graceful Elusion
abilities.effect: For the rest of the phase, friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY units have WARD (5+) until they have used a FIGHT ability.

entries.name: Shadow-Blooded
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Redeploy' command for a DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit wholly within 12" of this unit
entries.effect: If you roll a 1-3 when determining the distance that unit can move, you can use a value of 4 instead.

entries.name: Hand of Khaine
entries.declare: Pick an enemy HERO in combat with this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target's Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed. If the target is destroyed by this ability, this unit can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Murderous Duellist
entries.declare: Pick an enemy unit that has no more than 1 model and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Control characteristic, for the rest of the turn, if this unit is in combat with the target when the target is picked to use a FIGHT ability, all of the target's attacks must target this unit.

entries.name: Murder Manifested
entries.timing: Reaction: This unit used the 'Activate Place of Power' ability
entries.effect:
Apply the effect below instead of the effect of that 'Activate Place of Power' ability.
Roll a dice. On a 1, inflict D3 mortal damage on this unit. On a 2+, if there are no friendly Avatars of Khaine on the battlefield, set up an Avatar of Khaine wholly within 12" of this unit, visible to it and more than 9" from all enemy units. This unit has summoned that MANIFESTATION.

entries.name: Loyal Unto Death
entries.declare: Pick another friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE HERO that has a Health characteristic that equals or exceeds this unit's Health characteristic to be the target.
entries.effect: For the rest of the battle, if this unit is within the target's combat range when the target would be destroyed, the target is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (D3) the target. Then, this unit is destroyed.

entries.name: Honoured Among Sects
entries.effect: If this unit is anointed, the effect of all blessings from the 'Blessings of Khaine' ability apply to this unit as if they were active.

entries.name: Crimson Draught
entries.effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.

entries.name: Darkling Elixir
entries.declare: Pick a visible friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.

entries.name: Witchbrew
entries.declare: Pick a visible friendly non-UNIQUE DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Ulguan Reactions
entries.effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.name: Talismans of Shadow
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared a SPELL, PRAYER or UNBIND ability for a unit within 3" of this unit
entries.effect: Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, add 1 to that casting roll, chanting roll or unbinding roll.

entries.name: Tenebrous Aura
entries.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
entries.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• The target cannot use RETREAT abilities.
• If an ability would heal or return any slain models to the target unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.

entries.name: Steed of Shadows
entries.declare: Pick a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: The target can use CHARGE abilities this turn even if it used a RUN ability in the same turn.

entries.name: Mindrazor
entries.declare: Pick a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: The target's melee weapons have Charge (+1 Damage) until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Black Horror of Ulgu
entries.declare: Pick a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a point on the battlefield within 18" of them, pick up to 3 enemy units within 3" of that point to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: The targets cannot use RUN abilities until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Catechism of Murder
entries.declare: Pick a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: The target's melee weapons have Crit (Auto-wound) until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 7+, the target's combat attacks score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+ until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Covenant of the Iron Heart
entries.declare: Pick a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Add 10 to the target's control score until the start of your next turn. In addition, if the chanting roll was 6+, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to the target in each phase until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Dance of Doom
entries.declare: Pick a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly non-UNIQUE DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn. In
addition, if the chanting roll was 10+, the target can use 2 FIGHT abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Shadowstep
entries.declare: Pick a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of them and that has not been picked to be the target of this prayer this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: The target can move up to 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

entries.name: Scáthscale
entries.declare: Pick a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target that friendly unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY units while they are wholly within 12" of the target of this ability instead.

entries.name: Exultation of Murder
entries.declare: Pick a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE AELF INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks. In addition, if the chanting roll was 9+, until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons.

entries.name: Summon Bloodwrack Viper
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Bloodwrack Viper on the battlefield, pick a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Bloodwrack Viper wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Summon Heart of Fury
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Heart of Fury on the battlefield, pick a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Heart of Fury wholly within 18" of the caster and visible to them.

entries.name: Summon Bladewind
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Bladewind on the battlefield, pick a friendly DAUGHTERS OF KHAINE WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Bladewind wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
